_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.

anim._doc: T-083 (research/fable-tickets.md section 1.12 - the table is the spec; ENEMIES.md frozen, D-040). One entry per state of the section 1.12 table. Frames are file names relative to this folder (the T-016 names): idle_00.png (gin_idle_00) and launch_00.png (gin_launch_00) - the spec's two frames, exactly the two the TBD sheet carries. The void zone is VFX (tiles vanish) and has no frames. Art is real (game/tools/art/gin.gd, ticket T-ART-GIN); the timings stay exactly as the table says. Driven by the SIM state and its tick counter, never a wall-clock timer.

spawn.timing_note: common fade (section 1.0): alpha 0 -> 1 over 30 ticks, scale 0.8 -> 1.0; fades in 15-25 u from the player, on a platform tile only (farthest hub tile as fallback, D-072); the body cannot touch or kill until the fade completes

params.patch: 5x5 tiles centred on the player's tile
params.cracks: spread from the patch centre and reach the edge on tick 120

telegraph.timing_note: 120 ticks (2.0 s), binding; the 5x5 patch centred on the player's tile gets a red outline that blinks at 2 Hz for 60 ticks then 4 Hz for 60 ticks; cracks spread from the patch centre and reach the edge on tick 120 (the crack_rumble cue); gin does not mark while address me's countdown runs (SR-4)

attack_launch.timing_note: shown on tick 120; the spears travel for 18 ticks (0.3 s) - the launch frame is held for the flight; 5 white spear streaks from gin to the patch, view-layer only, never simulated

attack_void_zone.timing_note: starts on tick 138 = the tick the tiles become non-solid (120-tick mark + 18-tick spear flight); lasts 600 ticks (10 s); the tiles vanish; a dark column with a red rim marks the lethal volume; anything entering the column is killed

recover.timing_note: loop; the tiles fade back over 30 ticks (0.5 s) - a player inside is lifted onto the surface; cooldown 840 ticks (14 s; -3 s per extra vote, min 300 ticks = 5 s); he fades out 60 ticks after the launch and fades in again for the next strike
